description: This file defines a list of optional bundled cluster identifiers, provides functions to check if a cluster is included in that list, and determines whether optional bundled clusters should be included or built based on environment variables and package information.

methods.name: isOptionalBundledCluster
methods.description: Checks if the given cluster name is in the list of optional bundled clusters.

methods.name: shouldIncludeOptionalBundledClusters
methods.description: Determines if optional bundled clusters should be included based on the environment variable.

methods.name: hasReleasedBundledInstall
methods.description: Checks if the package JSON indicates a released bundled install by verifying the presence of a non-empty npmSpec string.

methods.name: shouldBuildBundledCluster
methods.description: Decides whether to build a specific bundled cluster based on package release status, environment settings, and whether the cluster is optional.
